reply.text:
Dosing SARMs is not something I'll do, and that's a line I hold for everyone. They're unapproved compounds with real health risks, and the right person to talk to about them is a doctor, who can look at your bloods and your history.

What I can do is the training side of a bulk. Progressive overload on the big lifts, enough sleep, and eating enough consistently are what move the scale in the right direction. If you want, I can build you a muscle-focused program, or set up targets for a gain phase.
